title: Tube sheet drilling
description: Tube sheet drilling capability for titanium components
processDescription: Laser drilling of titanium uses pulsed laser energy to create precise holes through percussion or trepanning methods. Hole diameters range from 0.05 mm to 3 mm with aspect ratios up to 20:1, specifically for tubes. Precision tubes for chemical, aerospace, and medical applications present unique challenges: wall thickness uniformity (±0.05 mm) over long lengths, internal surface finish Ra < 0.8 µm for fluid flow, and bent tube ovality control.
heatControl: Pulsed fiber laser with nitrogen assist gas. Pulse energy and frequency are controlled to minimize the recast layer.
flatnessControl: Non-contact process; no mechanical distortion. Vacuum fixturing for thin foil.
capabilitiesDescription: Integrated manufacturing capability for Tube sheet drilling, supported by in-house QC, material certification, and engineering review.
